### Required Attachments
*Please check the boxes below to confirm you have attached the diagnostic files:*
- [ ] I have attached `mods/enhancer/enhancer.log` (generated by `version.dll` / `mods/enhancer/*.asi`).
- [ ] In case of a crash, I have attached the crash dump folder (`mods/memory_dumps/dump_*`) containing `memory_report.txt`, `acz_process.dmp` (if enabled), and `screenshot.png` (if generated).

- **Game Version (`acz.exe`)**: *(e.g. `1.0.2.1` or `2.0.0.1 Standalone Steam`)*

- **GPU Model & VRAM**: *(e.g. `RTX 3060 12 GB` / `GTX 1650 4 GB` / `Steam Deck`)*
- **Other Mods Installed**: *(e.g. None, `custom textures.zip`, `actrilogy-hud-upgrade-v1.2.1.zip`, `version_orig.dll` + `.arc` mods)*
